name: Pig
overview: Scripture clearly identifies the pig as an unclean animal, as seen in Leviticus 11:7 where the swine, despite having cloven hooves, does not chew the cud and is therefore declared unclean for consumption. This dietary restriction reflects God's holiness and the call for His people to live distinctively. Additionally, Jesus uses the image of swine metaphorically in Matthew 7:6 to warn believers against giving what is holy to those who will not value it, illustrating the pig's symbolic association with impurity and disrespect.
